subject: Procurement constraints for AcuHealth pilot — AP-only / marketplace onboarding
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Riddle <sam.riddle@acuhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Procurement constraints for AcuHealth pilot — AP-only / marketplace onboarding

Sam — great convo this morning, thank you. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before legal/procurement dig in:

- Summary: AcuHealth is excited to pilot Redwood for secure inference on clinical summarization. Rough start: 3 devs, ~100k tokens/month expected during pilot.
- Procurement constraint you flagged: AcuHealth requires purchases to be processed via their AP tooling / marketplace (Ariba/Workday) and cannot accept a vendor-issued PO or corporate card payment.
- Ask: Can you confirm whether the marketplace path will allow us to (a) receive an invoice from Redwood and (b) be paid net-30? If the marketplace requires a vendor onboarding bundle we should get that started now.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sam to share the procurement contact or marketplace vendor link (procurement@acuhealth or portal URL).
2) Redwood (Laura + Monica) to review the redacted procurement policy and advise if we need a finance exception (prepay / non-standard terms).
3) If an exception is required, Redwood will prepare a short commercial exception request and estimate of onboarding lead time.

Attachments: I’ve attached a draft SOW and the redacted procurement snippet you referenced.

Thanks — I’ll hold off on scheduling the integration kickoff until procurement path is confirmed.

— Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: AcuHealth_Procurement_Policy_redacted.pdf (8KB)
From: Sam Riddle <sam.riddle@acuhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acuhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T13:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Procurement constraints for AcuHealth pilot — AP-only / marketplace onboarding

Hi Marcus — thanks for the recap and for sending the SOW. Confirming the constraint: our vendor policy requires new vendors to come through the marketplace (Workday vendor portal). We do not issue vendor-side POs and we do not put vendor charges on corporate cards. The typical flow is:

- Vendor registers in our portal, we create a vendor record.
- Finance initiates purchase via marketplace (we can authorize subscriptions / SaaS purchases).
- Payment is processed via our central AP system net-30 after invoice reconciliation.

I’m copying procurement@acuhealth.com — please work with them directly to get the vendor onboarding form. We can expedite for pilots but we won’t deviate from marketplace-only purchases.

— Sam
Director, Digital Ops | AcuHealth
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acuhealth.com>
Cc: Sam Riddle <sam.riddle@acuhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T15:47:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Procurement constraints for AcuHealth pilot — AP-only / marketplace onboarding

Hi Procurement Team — looping in our internal procurement/legal leads. We received a note that AcuHealth requires marketplace-only onboarding (Workday). Two quick questions for Laura/Monica from our side:

- Can Redwood accept marketplace-initiated purchase flow (vendor record + invoice net-30) without requiring prepayment or a Redwood-issued PO?
- If Redwood cannot accept that workflow out-of-the-box, what documentation or contract amendments do you need to start a credit / terms exception?

We have a small pilot (deal ACU-2026-PILOT-87) and the customer is asking to expedite vendor onboarding. Laura/Monica — I attached the redacted procurement policy they shared. Appreciate a fast look so we can advise AcuHealth.

Thanks — Marcus
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Riddle <sam.riddle@acuhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acuhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T16:30:00-04:00
Subject: RE: Procurement constraints for AcuHealth pilot — AP-only / marketplace onboarding

Marcus / Monica — reviewed AcuHealth’s redacted policy. Short answer: we can work through a marketplace vendor flow, but it will require two internal approvals: (1) Finance sign-off to invoice net-30 for a new vendor without an upfront deposit, and (2) Sales Ops to confirm billing setup for their Workday/Ariba connector.

Proposed internal path: I will open an exception request with Finance (template attached) seeking a single-invoice net-30 term for the pilot with a $0 prepay. To increase approval likelihood, please include the following and paste into the exception template:
- Strategic rationale: pilot with clinical summarization team; potential enterprise contract if pilot meets KPIs (~$300k ARR).
- Estimated pilot spend and timeline: ~$6k over 90 days.
- Risk mitigations: default to sandbox data; limited seats; SLAs for data retention; Redwood to provide proof of SOC2 and penetration test results.

Sam / AcuHealth procurement — if the marketplace team can generate an initial purchase order id or vendor onboarding link and confirm expected vendor-pay cycle (e.g., vendor payment timeline once invoice submitted), that will materially speed Finance review. If AcuHealth requires any specific contract language (IP, data residency, indemnity caps) please flag those now — we can surface to Legal.

I’ll start the Finance exception in the morning and loop back within 24 hours.

— Laura
Senior Counsel, Commercial | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: Finance_Exception_Request_Template.docx (6KB)
